The training of system upgrades the database of the system and further it is tested to enhance interaction among the speech and the text information. The proposed mechanism is evaluated to have high efficiency because the word error rate for each set of words was very low.

articleTitle: Cyber Security Metrics for Performance Measurement in E-Business
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: If there used to be ever a vicinity that holds both outstanding promise and extremely true workable for misuse and confusion in E-Business, it is Cyber Security Performance Metrics. Metrics are tools that supply situational recognition and are instrumental to assist chief ship to prioritize decision making. This paper addresses the recommendation of cyber security matrices assessment methodology.

articleTitle: Automatic Face Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The main purpose of this talk is to give some introduction about the requirements and uses of facial expression recognition. Non-verbal form of communication is facial expression. It helps to express the human attitude and also recognize his or her mental condition. Numbers of research have been carried out over the past two decades for enhancing the human computer interaction. This paper contains the some information about facial expression recognition, application, related study of face expression recognition strategies and steps.

articleTitle: MCAS : A collision sustenance mechanism for motorcyclists
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: With the rapid growth of cities and urban modes of transport, motorcycles and scooters have evolved to become the key medium of commute in many developing nations. Inherently motorcycles are more susceptible to accidents due to their poor stability and high centre of gravity. In the event of a motorcycle accident, the response time of the emergency services is highly critical and requires a fail-proof system to ensure the alert reaches at once. This paper proposes a collision alert system termed MCAS(Motorcycle collision alert system) that can be equipped on motorcycles and scooters. The MCAS system gets triggered upon a crash and ensures that an alert containing the vehicle's location, identifying details about the rider and the motorcycle is passed to the nearest hospital, police station and guardian of the victim. This is achieved by means of a GPS, GSM and Arduino module mounted on a shock proof casing which is secured on the chassis of the motorcycle. Force sensors are fixed across several impact points on the crash guard of the motorcycle and are connected to the arduino board. The system is powered by a mobile app which can be configured for the motorcyclist as well as their guardian. The entire system is supported by a cloud server to ensure minimum latency and guarantees a fail-proof system.

articleTitle: A Study on Performance Analysis for Different Wordpress and Hand Code Webpages
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: With website optimizations being a major concern in today's context given that all pages include dynamic images and faster loading algorithms, it is essential to decide the factors that make a website load in the minimal amount of time. In the current scenarios there are two types of web designing among the vast that is majorly used for building websites that include Plugins based and hand code based. Our aim is to analyze the different dynamic load times of the pages of the same text and images and compare the efficiency according to the type of base in which the website is loaded. For a case consider a website that has rather a large image but is optimized well but there is another webpage with the exact same theme that is constructed with the intent of making it the most optimized one. In this article the authors have analyzed the load time efficiencies that affects the load time of the website across servers from different parts of the world. Hence, this research can easily stipulate the required times for a fully functional website that constructs a well-balanced data of user interface based pages and goes easy on the servers. The intent of the research is to classify the Web pages according to their type and analyze what method of webpage is best suitable for the development..

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of MEMS based GMI Sensor for Detection of Gastric Cancer Cells
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The magnetoimpedance effect lead to the invention of magnetoimpedance sensor. But the applications in the biomedical field are still in infancy. The magnetoimpedance effect in soft magnetic wires and films has been abridged in this paper. The development in magnetoimpedance based bio-sensing application, which consists of detection of certain magnetic materials like magnetic ferro fluid, magnetic beads, magnetic nanoparticles and bio magnetic fields of living systems were outlined. A clear and detailed investigation on the moderation effect of biochemical liquids of the magnetic particles and the effect of stray magnetic field on the magnetoimpedance were investigated. Few positive approaches have been discussed for implementing the design of efficient magnetoimpedance biosensor. The results incur that magnetoimpedance sensors are very much Fitting for high sensitive identification of small mass of biomolecules of low concentration biomolecules, worthy for cancer cells detection in its budding stages.

articleTitle: A Virtual Model of 2D Planar Manipulator Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: As the robot manipulators are widely used in today's hi-tech industrialization for carrying out various tasks, the precise control of it necessitates further study. For conceptualizing the structure, characteristics and functionality of robot under different circumstances, the demand of virtual modelling increased. As robot manipulator's dynamics as well as kinematics (forward and inverse) are nonlinear in nature and are computationally intensive, a virtual model in MATLAB & SIMULINK has been developed for the same. The dynamics based on Lagrangian-Euler form is presented and simulated by a PID controller.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Microcontroller Based Driver Impairment Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Driver fatigue and intoxication is evident from facial features such as eye and head movement. A driver impairment monitoring system has been designed, constructed and tested by monitoring characteristics like face angle, head movement, and blinking eye. The alcohol sensor (MQ3), the tilt sensor, IR sensor, a camera, GSM module and microcontroller were used this system. When the driver's closed eyes, head tilt for drowsiness, or alcohol consumption were detected for a certain time, the buzzer alerted the driver, and an SMS was sent to the vehicle owners. The deviations of the face angle were measured with 10 participants and the average accuracy was found to be high.

articleTitle: Tumor Markers for Cancer Detection using Optical Sensor
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The field of optical sensors is one of the rapid growing technique in the field of Electronics & Communication Engineering. It is used to sense some of the parameters like temperature, pressure, Epsilon value detection of liquid materials, measurement of displacement, etc. Even though there are different methods for cancer detection but the diagnosis is unclear. Depression Thermometer is one of the ways to detect cancer. There is a need of health care for the people of different ages across the country. Thus there is a need of the development of optical biomedical Sensors which are used for detection, diagnosis of various types of diseases at different levels. In this paper, mainly detection of brain cancer cell is done by using Epsilon values. By comparing normal & brain cancer Quality factors, detection of stage of cancer & also a good optical Sensor can be developed.

articleTitle: Wireless Synchronization of Robotic Arm With Human Movements Using Aurdino for Bomb Disposal
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The wretchedness of the soldiers working in the bomb defusing squad in the armed forces is crucial because of their risky lives. To aid their safety a Robotic arm was designed for disposing bomb mounted on mobile base. This robotic arm defuses the bomb by synchronizing its arm movement with the movement of a bomb defusal officer who control's it from the distance. This model has been developed using both hardware and software components. It consists of two major parts. One is the Robotic arm and the other is a glove impregnated with sensors to control the Robotic arm from a particular distance. Human movements like finger movements, wrist's rotational movement and elbow movement will be precisely copied by the Robotic arm. This design is developed with Arduino developmental board, servo motors and Zigbee module. This work focuses on the safety of bomb squads from the life risky operation.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Planar Wideband Antenna for RF Front-end Multistandard Transceivers
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Planar Patch Antenna(PPA) is designed on FR4 substrate (ϵ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub>=4.4) and simulated in Keysight's Advance Design System (ADS) Momentum Microwave Software. The resonant frequency of the designed patch antenna is 3.5 GHz. It covers the Wi-MAX band between 3.25GHz to 3.65GHz. The return loss for designed antenna over the given band is -27.71dB, with gain 6dB. This antenna can give the best performance for recent RF Front-end multistandard traneivers.

articleTitle: Automatic Screening of Retinal Structrue using Adaptive Fuzzy Thresholding
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: We describe an adaptive thresholding method to identify the lesion present in the retina. Diabetic retinopathy [DR] happens when these small blood vessels leak blood and different liquids. [4] This makes the retinal tissue swell, bringing about overcast or obscured vision. A PC supported screening and reviewing framework depends on the programmed discovery of injuries is required for Screening of diabetic retinopathy. DR show dim lesions, for example, Micro aneurysms (MA) and haemorrhages (HE) and bright lesions, such as, exudates and cotton-fleece spots. [6] The existing systems utilized normal strategies, for example, thresholding. [10] However, after finding the detected vessels, these lesions are lost and not recovered in resulting handling and gives less characterization precision. With the end goal to stay away from this, a programmed recognition of both dim and bright lesions in image is presented and approved dependent on fuzzy thresholding technique that don't require exact division of the areas to be ordered. Blood vessels are separated utilizing Line Tracking Method. [7] Optic Disc (OD) is removed using the Morphological activities. Lesions are identified utilizing Adaptive Fuzzy Thresholding strategies.

articleTitle: Design, Fabrication and Control of Four Degrees of Freedom Serial Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this paper, a 4-DOF serial manipulator is designed, simulated, analyzed, fabricated and controlled. The manipulator is designed for a pick and place task. The DH parameters of the robotic arm are found and using Peter Corke's Robotics Toolbox for MATLAB, direct kinematic model of the manipulator is realized. The implementation of Robotics Toolbox is not so common to find in the literature. Each joint's position, speed and acceleration are plotted with respect to time. During fabrication and assembly, 4 servo motors are used. Arduino UNO board has been used for controlling the servo motors and potentiometer. It is extremely beneficial to have all the steps in a single article to realize a robot.

articleTitle: Open Source security and data segregation based on Subprofiles
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In today's world, open source software leverages more advantages to the world and the developer is becoming a state-of-the-art feature for every software that plays a crucial role in the process of technological evolution. Making the code available to the open world not only exposes the existing flaws, but also employs new ways to correct them and improvise it more better than what it is previously. In the following years of technological advancements open source software have proven to be the to-go solutions since it can be easily modified and improvised according to the needs of the organization. In the same road, we need to make open source more outsourced and at the same time, data segregation should be streamlined in an unsophisticated way to understand what people really need out of the software. In the modern days a profile represents an individual user in a pool and when the same user has multiple accounts, it becomes a tedious task to guess what exactly the user wants as a summary. To avoid that we create the idea of creating a set number of sub-profiles for all the existing profiles because the number of users in an open source software using only one account is very limited. By creating the ideology of sub-accounts, we can make the user tracking as a simplistic method and in a segregated manner and in this way it is easy to target ads, sell goodies and make other business based decisions on a particular account and also to make intricate decisions which will provide a considerable impact on the entire data management of the users in an open source environment.

articleTitle: Bit Error Rate Analysis of 16 X 16 MIMO - OFDM in Downlink transmission for LTE - A
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The fourth-generation (4G) cellular systems are assisted by radio access technologies comprising 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Long-Term Evolution (LTE), and its improved version, LTE-Advanced (LTE-A). Generally speaking, Release-10 of 3GPP standards is referred to as LTE-A, furthermore, its achievable execution makes it a genuine 4G innovation as per the definitions are given by the International Telecommunication Union (ITU). LTE/LTE-A are rising communication technologies in transit toward 5G communication systems. The LTE-Advanced system uses multiple input multiple output (MIMO) and orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) techniques in order to achieve a high data rate transmissions. In LTE maximum data rate expected is 100 Mbps for downlink transmission and 50 Mbps for uplink transmission. MIMO-OFDM realizes the utmost spectral efficiency and hence, delivers the maximum data throughput and capacity. This research work is dealing with the investigation of execution dependent on release 10 of the 3GPP standard and investigates the performance analysis of Turbo coded MIMO-OFDM in LTE-A networks using 64-QAM modulation technique and 256 subcarriers. Bit Error Rate (BER) and downlink throughput are evaluated in terms of Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR) with 16 × 16 MIMO configurations in downlink using MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Automatic Performance Evaluation of Smart Transmitters using Highway Addressable Remote Transducer Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Transmitters are being used for measurement and testing purpose. Prior to major testing, the sensor values from the Transmitters have to be manually simulated for verifying channel integrity. HART communication is introduced for Smart communication in order to reduce the human error and preparation time. Bidirectional HART communication provides access to additional information between the field devices and the host controller which can be developed using HART protocol, MTL4840-HART connection system, Smart Transmitters. HMS makes use of the FSK signal to superimpose digital communication signals from PC and communicate with the field devices with 1200bps without interrupting the 4-20mA signals. The PC with LabView software is connected to the HART communication system to have an automatic performance evaluation. Developed system will drastically reduce the preparation time and avoid human error.

articleTitle: Color Filter Array Directional Demosaicking with Compression using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The images of a single sensor camera have only one color component in a pixel array the missing two color components are reconstructed into a full color image by demosaicking. A new framework of combining an efficient Artificial Neural network Back propagation (ANN-BP) compression and Directional Demosaicking (DD). A three layered neural network is employed in the proposed work for achieving good compression strategy and a four directional demosaicking with bilateral filtering which helps to obtain good demosaicking results comparatively. The work is analyzed using the Kodak dataset.

articleTitle: A solution of combined static and dynamic Dispatch Problems using HB-SA Algorithm with valve point Effects
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In power system, the combined static/dynamic Economic and Emission dispatch (CEED) problems have always marred the accuracy of the system. In this research, a new strategy has been proposed in which Meta heuristic optimization algorithms such as Honey Bee's and Simulated Annealing techniques (SA) are clubbed to solve the CEED problems in power system. The analysis of both the techniques, when employed independently and when used in tandem, vindicates the assumption that the new technique proves to be much more efficient. An impending threat of global warming means, finding solution to Economic Dispatch problems also involves the crucial aspect of cutting down on pollutants emitted too. The efficacy of this method is demonstrated by considering valve point loading effects. A comparative study with various techniques reiterates the facts that the combined HB-SA approach is superior to them and that its potential to solve nonlinear CEED problems is unprecedented.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis of Micro-cantilever with a feedback circuit
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper presents analysis of electromechanical microcantilever with a feedback circuit. COMSOL/Multiphysics tool is used for design of cantilever and feedback circuit is designed in MATLAB/Simulink software. Cantilever material considered is Silicon. The conventional methods for the measurement of force on a microcantilever are optical or piezoresistive. The method proposed here helps in measuring the force applied on a microcantilever. As the cantilever tip is subjected to some input force it bends. This being is restored to its normal position by electromagnetic force. The required electromagnetic force is directly proportional to the deflection occurred because of actuation. This is a novel method of calculating the force using actuation voltage, which retain microcantilever to its original position.

articleTitle: Entropy of Tamil Language and Prioritized Coding Algorithm for Encoding of Tamil Letters
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this paper, the value of entropy of Tamil language estimated using statistical analysis is presented. The statistical method makes use of samples of text taken from different Tamil texts and entropy is calculated for the specific text. The value of entropy of the language as a whole is calculated by computing the average of the entropy obtained by considering various Tamil text samples. This paper also presents prioritized coding algorithm for efficient translation of Tamil letters to binary digits.. This paper discusses the basic model of prioritized coding algorithm with its implementation steps and compares its performance with other algorithms. The places where this algorithm performs better than Huffman coding algorithm is discussed and the relationship between the distribution of letters in the respective positions and the effect it has on the success of prioritized coding algorithm is highlighted. Also the text is encoded using an algorithm called as predictive guess coding based on the idea of converting the symbols to the number of guesses it takes to predict the symbol as proposed by C.E Shannon in his paper.

articleTitle: One Dimensional Two Phase Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: We developed a well defined method for two phase one dimensional Stefan problem. For a fixed space step, first two time steps are obtained in this paper using collocation. Subsequent step sizes are obtained by discrete form of the Stefan condition. This method is applicable to a wide range of problems. The method is illustrated by presenting examples. It is general enough to be applicable to a broad class of moving boundary problems including its extension to the multi phase problem resulting in a neat and powerful algorithm.

articleTitle: To compensate RoF non-linear transmission impairments: Simulation vs Analytical modeling
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this paper, validation of simulation results through analytical modelling has been presented to compensate the impact of non-linear transmission impairments such as Self-Phase Modulation (SPM), Four-Wave Mixing (FWM) and Cross-Phase Modulation (XPM)in RoF (Radio over Fiber) system. An analytical model has been designed and validated with the simulation results. The proposed analytical model utilizes SSP (Symmetrical-Symmetrical-Post), Bessel filter and PC-DCF (Post Compensating-Dispersion Compensation Fiber) compensation techniques in the transmission channel to mitigate SPM, FWM and XPM effects in RoF system. The simulation results indicate a reasonable improvement in OSNR by 2dB and by 5dB by using SSP and PC-DCF compensation technique. In addition to these results, reduction in FWM sideband power has been analyzed by 4dBm by the incorporation of Bessel Filter in the transmission channel. Through analytical modelling, it is seen that the simulation results obtained are in close proximity for compensating non-linear transmission effects such as SPM, FWM and XPM.

articleTitle: A review on Estimation of Chromatic Dispersion using Fractional Fourier Transform in Optical Fiber Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The present data bus competition among the telecom operators stresses their fiber backbone as increasing data speed adversely affects the range of communication by the chromatic dispersion. To encounter the rival, we have to estimate him. So we have referred various estimation techniques for determining chromatic dispersion by FrFT. These techniques of estimating the accumulated CD can be further improved by adding a variable FM signal in the same frequency band of the modulated signal. The variable chirping signal added to the blind modulated signal. At the Receiver end estimated the CD using FrFT technique and optimum order determining by PWD method. With this method, we are going to estimate CD error should be less than 85 ps/nm and total CD not greater than 30000 ps/nm

articleTitle: Error Performance Analysis of RF Subcarrier Adjusted FSO Communication Framework over Robust Environmental Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: RF subcarrier tweak in FSO correspondence framework end up well known step by step because of the enhancement in the framework execution, which are for the most part affected by the robust environmental disturbance due to turbulence. In this paper, we infer error execution limits for RF subcarrier adjusted FSO correspondence frameworks with synchronous RF demodulator working over solid environmental disturbance channel which is demonstrated by gamma-gamma. Execution results are assessed as far as normal CNR, BER and penalty of power endured by the framework because of turbulence impacts.

articleTitle: A Generic Layer Based Approach for Design of Software for Medical Imaging Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Advances in modern medical imaging technologies such as X-Ray, Computed Tomography (CT), Ultra Sound (US) imaging, Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), Positron emission tomography (PET) and Single Photon Emission Computed tomography (SPECT) enable better disease diagnoses and treatment assessment. This paper explains a layered architecture suitable for design and development of application software for medical imaging devices. The generic nature of medical imaging devices in the process of data acquisition, signals processing and image reconstruction is the major inspiration behind conceptualization of this architecture. Also the currently available medical imaging software follow a multi-stage interlinked processing workflow which can be directly mapped to the layered software approach. Layered software approach facilitates quick and easy customization, configuration and feature enhancements of the medical imaging software. The architecture facilitates the academic community or researchers to build end user solutions based on research outputs, which can be directly integrated and used in the main software workflow. This indeed provides opportunity for utilizing the technical expertise available for implementation of algorithms which can directly be used to interface with medical imaging devices. The architecture discussed in this paper, has been employed in the design of MRI imaging software as a case study to further illustrate its applicability in signal generation, data acquisition and image reconstruction.

articleTitle: A Morphological Approach to Match Two Color Images Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Comparing two color images and taking a decision about their similarity or dissimilarity is one of the fundamental applications in digital image processing field. If different features can be extracted from two images and compared, then by analyzing the result we can say about their similarity or dissimilarity. If the features extracted and edge detected has a similarity greater than a threshold value, then we can conclude that the images are same, otherwise they are different. In this paper, we have used mathematical morphology to compare two color images and implemented using a feed-forward Artificial Neural Network with two hidden layers. This method has been applied in real life images and given a successful and promising result.

articleTitle: Building Secure and Fast Selection based Random Key Generation using Programmable Cellular Automata with Check bit
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: With the popularity of cost-effective and technological advantages of cloud computing play an important role in information enabled services. Due to the lack of security and integrity are the main concerns in cloud and the present authentication mechanism do not provide adequate security in the cloud. Hence, this paper attempts to propose a selection based random key generation using programmable cellular automata for the public cloud which satisfies avalanche diffusion and confusion properties. It is found that by combining non-uniform cellular automata and programmable cellular automata mechanism, a robust master key in the public cloud could be generated. The simulation results show that the proposed method has large key space and protects the conventional brute force attack and chosen plaintext attack in addition to better execution time for accessing cloud data in the distributed environment. The theoretical analysis confirmed that the proposed programmable cellular automata based random key generation solution provides high security.

articleTitle: Pectoral Muscle Segmentation in the Identification of Breast Cancer
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Diseases are analyzed by different digital image processing techniques. The breast cancer should be detected earlier to improve the survival rates. The proposed work deals with the identification of the breast cancer using the pectoral muscle segmentation. The high sensitivity and accuracy of the proposed work shows its potential for clinical application. The tool used for this process is MATLAB Software.

articleTitle: Optimization of Binary Hologram Using Orthogonal Reference Pattern
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: This paper exhibits a novel implementation of optimization of binary holograms. It is necessary to reconstruct a quality image from a binary amplitude-only hologram. The optimization of binary holograms plays a pivotal role in holographic data storage system as they are better in terms of size and easiness in generating. Many binarization methods are executed but there are pitfalls while reconstructing them. This paper makes use of advanced reference patterns with which improved reconstructed images are retrieved.

articleTitle: Motion Detection and Extraction of Human Body Using Hybrid Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In recent time digital image processing and its importance have increased significantly, subject to the development of automation systems. Digital image processing and related research areas have been paved for the invention of high end applications in pharmaceutical, robotics, satellite image processing, genetics etc. Many applications have been found in daily applications around human beings in image processing. Therefore, in real time images and video sequences are essential for locating human bodies and have been entered. In this paper, a bottom-up methodology is proposed for automatic detection and extraction of human bodies from single images. Work of this paper is Design and development of a hybrid algorithm for detection and extraction of human bodies from different images and currencies. Use of Artificial Intelligence and Automatic Learning with the combination of image processing techniques to detect and split different human currencies and movements on the basis of structure. The use of vision processing has also been proposed to allow the application of the system in real-time video received from various sources, such as CCTV, Motion Capture Camera etc. The purpose of the proposed system is to be much faster than the existing algorithm, and therefore the task of reducing the complexity of the location and time of the existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Collision Avoidance Mechanism in Vehicles using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport) is a lightweight messaging protocol that provides resource-constrained network clients with a simple way to distribute telemetry information. Once the telemetry information is obtained the three data position, speed and distance between the vehicles is fed to the neural network, back propagation algorithm is programmed in the raspberry pi. The two outputs from the neural network are fed to the output ports in raspberry pi where they are amplified. One port is fed to the electronically controlled braking mechanisms to control the car and the other given to the fuel control to carburetor to reduce acceleration and avoid collision. In addition local sensors from On-Board Diagnostics (OBD) devices of the car are used as additional information in failure of Global Positioning System (GPS). In this paper, an effort is made to demonstrate the implementation of MQTT based collision avoidance mechanism using neural networks for transport safety. If this technology is implemented by Dubai Roads and Transport Authority (RTA), it will benefit the society widely.

articleTitle: Multiple Constant Multiplication Based Variable Size Partitioning Fir Filters
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Finite Impulse Response (FIR) filters are the most important elements in digital signal processing that are packed with dedicated hardware instead of software to improve the speed. Implement the reconfigurable filter architectures to obtain a low power, high speed implementation of variable size partitioning FIR filter. By using the Multiple Constant Multiplication (MCM) technique the computationally efficient low power, high speed RADIX-2^r variable size FIR filter would be designed. To realize both low pass and high pass filter, module based dynamic partial reconfiguration is proposed and it also reduce the reconfiguration time. The FIR filters are designed using the tool Xilinx13.2. Filters are dynamically reconfigured by modifying the filter's coefficients.

articleTitle: Spider Monkey Optimization Technique For Damping Inter Area Oscillations Through Unified Design of PSS and TCSC
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Nowadays electromechanical oscillations of lower frequencies (LFO) have become a quite common phenomenon in modern power systems, posing a major threat to stability and security of the systems. For mitigation of these oscillations to improve system stability, Power System Stabilizers (PSS) are provided in power systems. However, in cases of certain faults and increased loading in a transmission line, equipping power systems with only PSS might not be enough. For better controllability as well as improved stability, Flexible AC Transmission System (FACTS) technologies are predominantly used in power systems. With unified use of FACTS devices along with PSS, there is improvement not only in just control of the power flow and response but also further enhancement in power system stability by damping out oscillations. Thyristor Controlled Series Capacitor (TCSC) is a modern versatile FACTS device extensively used in power systems for its effectiveness in rapid regulation of voltage, maintenance of balance in power flow and hence leading to greater stability limits as compared to other FACTS devices. However the linear control methods might not be effective in design of coordinated parameters. Hence taking nonlinearities in power system into consideration, a robust and unique evolutionary optimization technique termed as `Spider Monkey Algorithm' is used for dynamic tuning of PID specifications of PSS for improvement of system stability to a much greater extent. The SMO based PID controller is designed and compared with conventional PID for justification and validation of the enhancement achieved, in terms of transient stability performance using MATLAB/SIMULINK environment by subjecting it to non linear loading conditions. The results demonstrate greater transient performance and immense potential of dynamically tuned SMO technique based PSS-PID of the two machine system as compared to the conventional PSS based PID controller.

articleTitle: A Survey on Morphological Assessment of Knee Articular Cartilage from MR Images
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Nowadays, articular disorders and musculoskeletal diseases are one of the major health issues and attack usually the older generations. The human knee joint is commonly infected by osteoarthritis (OA) disease. OA can affect the joints of the spine, fingers, thumbs, hips, knees, and toes, but it is most prevalent in the knee and hip joints. Here we are concentrating only on Knee joints. Knee Osteoarthritis is a serious, excruciating & potentially life-threatening joint disease, may lead to permanent disability. It can be detected by measuring changes in knee internal tissues such as cartilage, meniscus and Subchondral Cartilage. For detecting knee osteoarthritis, Magnetic Resonance Imaging is performed to obtain a detailed picture of knee joint and change are measured from MR images. MRI is a test that uses powerful magnets, radio waves, and a make to comprehensive pictures inside our body. The main objective is to develop a fully automated non-contrast MRI application for detection and Segmentation of knee bones. The proposed approach is based on Convolution Neural Network to achieve a robust and perfect segmentation of even highly pathological knee structures.

articleTitle: Flux Related Analysis of Three Phase Asynchronous Motor based on Dual Order Integrator Frequency-locked loop
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Now a days, high speed, high power three-phase Induction Motors (IM) are generally utilized in a large portion of uses of modern. Due to recent advancement in power electronics devices, power electronics based converter technology is the most famous than the conventional speed control techniques. The main speed controlling techniques can be classified as Flux Related Control and Direct Torque Control technique. The essential need of the various speed control technique is to do flux estimation. The numerous flux estimation techniques have been researched till date. Among these techniques, one of the full order observer techniques has less scope due to complexity in implementation. The other technique was voltage model based flux estimation technique. In this technique, The estimation of stator flux by integrating the back EMF. But the open loop integration of back EMF caused the starting value problem. Also, the quadrature detector technique for flux estimation is utilized to find the orthogonality between the calculated field and the back EMF. Notwithstanding, the symmetry will be not exact, on the grounds that the extent of the initiated emf turns out to be little at low speed, that makes the dc counterbalance and different unsettling influences to the ascendant signs. So to overcome this issues and improve accuracy and for proper field calculation dual order integrator loop is use. Which attenuate higher order harmonics and dynamic performance is improved.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of classification algorithms on Lymph disease prediction
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In the last decade, a large number of computer aided diagnosis (CAD) tools are developed for the identification of different algorithm. For the disease diagnosis, classification algorithms based on ML (ML) techniques are commonly used. The classification algorithm uses a supervised learning methodology to makes the system or computer program to learn from the given input data and then employ the learning knowledge to identify the upcoming observations. This paper intends to evaluate the different classification algorithms namely radial basis function (RBF), Naive Bayes (NB), J48 and Olex-GA on the identification of Lymph diseases. For the performance evaluation of different classifiers, a benchmark Lymph dataset is used interms of different performance measures. The obtained results proved that the RBF network attained better performance compared to NB, J48 and Olex-GA.

articleTitle: IoT Based Driving Risk Assessment and Warning System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Drivers of vehicles encounter various risks both external and internal during their course of operation of a vehicle on the road. One such risk is the proximity of vehicle with respect to another vehicle or an obstacle. This IoT based project examines a solution which directs/assists the driver to maintain a specified safe distance between vehicles on roads to and avoid unsafe conditions leading to accidents. In the event of lack of attention on behalf of the driver or temporary distraction, the system is designed to alert him to the required focus on the road. The project will attempt to examine the possible risk factors both qualitatively and quantitatively in order to incorporate data-based features into the system. Evaluation of the risk factors will be done through the study of published causes of road accidents in India. The results shall be in the form of a sensor graph which can be used to design the system and offer a standalone solution. The sensor data in the form of sensor graph can be served as the primary measure to take better decisions for secure and safe transportation. The system has the potential to improve the overall road safety, improve drivers standards by revising training, be used as a monitoring tool, analysis of accidents etc. using graphical representation, trend analysis etc., with the use of trend analysis the roads could be categorized as roads for safe transport or roads that are dangerous. It can also be used as a tool to identify dangerous roads.

articleTitle: MONITROID: A Runtime Smart Alert Malware Detection System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Smart phone has established itself as an inevitable part of one's life. Hence the growth rate of smart phone is expanding every year. In addition to the basic communication services such as voice calls and SMS a smart phone provides a wide variety of useful services such as internet connectivity, gaming, wireless connections with other devices, global positioning systems, digital camera, embedded memory etc. The improved popularity of Android devices and their convenient price attracted the malware developers also, which results in a drastic growth in the development of the Android malware applications (apps), between 2010 and 2018. Researchers have discovered that about four million new malware samples are developed and spread across the android market per year, and it was reported that more than 90% of these new malware samples belongs to any of the existing malware families. Through this paper, we propose a framework named MONITROID which generates a smart alert whenever a malicious app is launched in a user's phone. The alert message informs users about the dangerous impact of currently executing application. The backend server performs a massive malware detection and the identification of the malware family.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of TCM aided Block Diagonalization using STBCs for MIMO systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: By using Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) Systems we can achieve low bit error rates which in turn result in highly reliable systems. Assuming that channel state information is known, we have designed a Trellis Coded Modulation (TCM) aided Block Diagonalization (BD) technique using Space Time Block Codes (STBCs). The application of above technique to MIMO systems results in decrease of bit error rates as Block Diagonalization (BD) reduces Multi User Interference (MUI), while TCM provides efficient channel encoding/decoding, and STBC reduces signal fading effects.

articleTitle: Survey of Web-Based Project Management System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: A project management system is a means of project planning, organizing, and managing its different required aspects. Many researchers have used many techniques for automating the project management system by providing features such as real-time tracking, scheduling, and task management. Task management is the prime features of the project management system which includes on-time completion, report generation, work distribution and which forms the basis of successful project management. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of all such web-based project management system and proposes a system based on the findings.

articleTitle: A Survival Study on Classification Methods with Geospatial Data
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Data mining is method of determining patterns in large datasets. The spatial information includes position of spatial features, association of geospatial features and measurement values. Spatial data comprises points, lines, polygons, geographic and geometric information primitives that is mapped through location, stored with object as metadata. Spatial data is employed for communication to find user devices. This study compares different existing spatial data classification techniques with geospatial information. Many researchers carried out their research on spatial data classification. However, classification accuracy and time performances were not enhanced. Our objective is to improve the performance of spatial data classification at higher accuracy and lesser time.

articleTitle: LI-RMLO: Loop Iteration based Runtime Method Level Offloading for Mobile Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Application partitioning is of particular importance to address the long communication delay issue which occurs during offloading from mobile device to cloud. With the launch of mobile edge framework, the connection delay tends to get reduced to a certain extent and paves the way for utilizing neighbourhood competent mobile devices for taking care of intensive computations of fragile devices. While Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) transforms the Mobile cloud computing in one way, the improvisation in shortening the granularity of code to be offloaded is raising on the other side. Method Level Offloading (MLO) is one such solution of code granularity reduction which is discussed in many research works. Our proposed model, Loop Iteration based Runtime Method Level Offloading (LI-RMLO) adopts MLO to offload applications having iterative and independent methods that behaves diverse to smaller and larger inputs. In such cases, the method which is labeled as offloadable never needs to be executed in the remote machine for all runs. Instead our model analyzes the iteration limit of the method at runtime and decides to offload only when the local execution time of the method exceeds its remote execution time. By this adaptation, we achieve an optimal offloading performance and ward off unwanted offloading to the proximate edge nodes.

articleTitle: Control Strategies of Micro Grid With UPFC Using ISCPWM Inverter
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this project, the design and development of Unified Power Flow Compensator (UPFC) using Four Switch Three Phase Inverter (SSTPI) for micro grid power system is proposed. To analyze this power configuration, different control strategies are to be analyzed such as Pulse Width Modulation (PWM), Sinusoidal Pulse Width Modulation (SPWM), Inverted Sinusoidal Carrier Pulse Width Modulation (ISCPWM). This project deals with the simulation of ISCPWM controller based UPFC for micro grid application for different loads using matlab/simulink software and the design of ISCPWM inverter. By the comparative analysis the effectiveness of the UPFC in power system will be illustrated.

articleTitle: Fault Recognition and Isolation Scheme for Spacecraft Propulsion System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this work proposes a back propagation algorithm neural network methodology for fault recognition and separation operation for the parallel plate solid spacecraft thruster (PPT) electrical discharge of a spacecraft. Based on the electromechanical model of PPT, its operation is verified. The model represents an LRC circuit with a dynamic equation for the ablated plasma and configuration parameters on PPT performance are implemented in mat lab. The aim is to find the faults in the electrical discharge of the thruster. Then the values are evaluated with dynamic neural network back propagation network, based on the output data parameters which are adjusted to minimize the faults. The training phase concludes and diagnosis the occurrence of a defective propulsion system. The validation phase recognizes which system is unhealthy, i.e. it separates the settings of the fault. Based on the neural network scheme simulations are done and verified by using Matlab.

articleTitle: Secure Data Hiding Based on Most Significant Bit Error Prediction Mechanism using Blow Fish Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this research module, a transportation builds in the digital image and communication stage of network safety process which is dependable to face the profitable and non-commercial IT expansion communities of data streams in high dimensional data group modeling. Reversible data hiding in encrypted images is one of the schemes that can be used for secrets to hide the image when we transfer the image through a network. The method RDHE is used to encrypt a furtive image or file by flouting into shares. To take the gain of these goods, the third person can recover the furtive image if they sharing a furtive image are transmitted through the network. This module presents a model within reach of to encrypt generated image shares of Visual Cryptography using Public key Encryption. We used BlowFish algorithm in order to provide the dual security of the file. Those who make the fake creation of data while transferring the furtive image, the image which can send through the network which is furtive to the third person. The proposed method provides shares that are more furtive and robust beside amount of crisis. This method provides more furtive for images, documentation and hand written files, etc. This method mostly executes in public networks. The simulation tool used for this research module is MATLAB.

articleTitle: Analytical Performance Evaluation of an LDPC Coded FSO Communication System under Strong Atmospheric Turbulence
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: FSO communication frameworks are impeded by unfavorable climate conditions, for example, rain, haze, cloud, snow and environmental turbulences. In any case, to limit the dangerous impact of atmospheric turbulence, modulation technique itself isn't adequate to enhance the exhibitions of FSO communication framework. In that angle the channel coding with various tweak strategies have just been accounted for in several publications. A large portion of the examination works depend on PC reproduction. Here we provide an investigative methodology to assess the BER execution of a FSO correspondence framework by utilizing LDPC code in RF carrier with Q-ary Pulse Position modulation under the influence of atmospheric turbulence. Execution outputs are assessed as far as BER for both uncoded and LDPC coded framework. Examination demonstrated that LDPC coded framework gives huge enhancement of BER under coded condition with 8-ary Optical PPM tweak organize.

articleTitle: Block Level based Data Deduplication and Assured Deletion in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: With the progression of web, an ever increasing number of individuals have begun to outsource information on cloud. However, sending information to an outsider creates opportunity for attackers to easily retrieve data. Because of simplicity, individuals regularly tend to store excess information on the cloud. This leads to wastage and increase in the cost of storage space. As nobody knows where the information is put away on cloud; it is likewise vital to certainly erase information from cloud. Hence along with security, data deduplication and assured deletion are the major concerns in cloud storage. In this paper, we put-forth an application based on block level based file deduplication scheme over fragmented blocks that addresses the issue of duplication in the cloud storage platform. We also focus on guaranteed erasure using user defined policies. Thus on expiry of a policy, the keys are deleted therefore making the file inaccessible to anyone including the proprietor.

articleTitle: A Proportional Resonant Power Controller and A Combined Amplitude Adaptive Notch Filter with PLL for Better Power Control and Synchronization of Single Phase On Grid Solar Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: In this paper, a modified hybrid synchronization technique to improve the synchronization process and one power control and management scheme during normal and abnormal condition of a single-phase grid connected solar photovoltaic (SPGCSPV) system have been proposed. Generally, ZCD (Zero Crossing Detection) and second-order generalized integrator (SOGI) based phase-locked loops (PLLs) are widely used for grid synchronization in SPGC inverter. However, adaptive notch filter (ANF) based algorithm is also gaining attention due to its simplicity and accuracy. In this work, to improve the synchronization technique with reduced steady state phase error, reduced allowable lock range and improved synchronization speed, an amplitude adaptive notch filter (AANF) is used with combining PLL with it, to implement a new AANF-PLL with control in d-q (direct-quadrature) frame. It gives very good response with the voltage and frequency variation. Further, modified technique can also be used in the detection of signal amplitude, harmonics, frequency, and control of power. The simulation study of the SPGCSPV system has been done using MATLAB/SIMULINK environment followed by hardware implementation for performance monitoring, anti-islanding, and low voltage ride through (LVRT) capability testing.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection Approaches: A Review
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Out of many diseases in medical science one of the rigorous problems, the World is facing today is Brain Tumor. Brain Tumor is an uncontrollable cell proliferation in the brain. Tumor can be detected using medical imaging techniques like Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), But drawback is it cannot detect below 3 mm size. Hence for accurate analysis of Brain tumor, Segmentation is one of the tools that are extensively used in Medical Science. Segmentation is one of the methods to partition an image into regions. Segmentation discriminates healthy tissues from affected tissues. This makes easier for quantative analysis, accurate disease diagnosis, detection and classification of Brain tumor. As already lot of tumor segmentation methods are available, still more research should take place in this area. The reason is these MRI image display complex characteristics like high diversity in appearance of tumor and unclear tumor boundaries. Hence judicious disease diagnosis with scientific proof is essential. So that early planning can be done to save the life of patient. To facilitate the researchers working in this field, a review on various Brain Tumor segmentation is presented. The study emphasises the greater confrontation we come across while tumor Segmentation on various methods in the literature, as well. It is trusted that the methodologies and experiments put forth in this study will be of great use for researchers working in this field.

articleTitle: Detection and Prediction of Breast Cancer Using CNN-MDRP Algorithm in Big Data and Machine Learning: Study and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: The rapidly growing sector of big-data analysis [1] shows primal function in devolution of recitations and an inquiry in the health sector. It has provided tools to roll up, succeed, examine and absorb large mass of integrated and ambiguous data which is, produced by incumbent health care systems. Big Data Analysis has recently been applied to help in the process of attention and disease exploration. However, the degree of acceptance and development of research in this space has been hampered by some underlying problems inherent the big data paradigm. Here, we have optimized machine erudition-formula for the impressive prevision of epidemics of prolonged diseases in communities of predominant diseases. Here the newfound multimodal disease prediction algorithm for convolutional neuronal networks (CNN-MDRP) that uses structured and unstructured hospital data.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Agile Software Development Methodology Selection Using Fuzzy Inference System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: An Agile Methodology of software development has been more popular in the software industry in terms of fast software delivery, less documentation, more satisfaction and more interactions between developers and users. In this paper Fuzzy Inference System based model is proposed to select an appropriate agile method for successful software development. A number of agile methods such as Extreme Programming (XP), Scrum, Feature Driven Development (FDD) and Dynamic System Development Method (DSDM) have been proposed in the literature. Selection of an appropriate method for a given project is a pivotal and a challenging issue. As a solution to this problem, the projects are categorized into four classes namely, Small scale, Medium scale, large scale and safety critical projects, where project size is estimated based on programmer months (PM) and the proposed model is applied to select the most appropriate agile method for each of the project category. MATLAB Simulation results reveal that the proposed model is efficient in predicting the suitability of one of the agile methods.

articleTitle: Spectrum Sensing in Cognitive Radio Enabled Wireless Sensor Networks using Discrete Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks are considered as a most enabling technology that holds confront of offering smart communication model where application development based on requirements. Cognitive agents are competent of generating proactive decisions with respect to sharing information when combined in sensor networks which helps in attaining the objective of the sensor network, in optimization crisis and enormous constraints. Cognitive radio (CR) at the physical layer facilitates opportunistic utilization of heterogeneous environment where sensor network is deployed. CR provides appealing solution for proficient utilization of radio frequency spectrum and has increased interest over field of research as of current years. Spectrum sensing (SS) is the principle target of CR and recognizes nearness of idle channel of the frequency spectrum. CR, an intelligent SS innovation distinguishes white spaces or spectrum hole areas in the range which reallocates idle spectrum to unlicensed clients known as Secondary Users (SU) and without making destructive interference to clients known as Primary Users (PU). In this paper, a technique for predicting the channel state utilizing Discrete Markov Model (DMM) is anticipated. A comprehensive investigation is done amongst anticipated strategy with the conventional spectrum sensing method. Here, a framework of spectrum sensing utilized in cognitive radio sensor networks (CRSN) are discussed and analyzed using MATLAB simulator.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable FIR Filters: A survey
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Smart Systems and Inventive Technology (ICSSIT)
abstract: From the dawn of the VLSI based approach for the digital signal processing at most research is centered upon the digital filters and their designing, as filters are the circuit elements which are mainly used in signal processing where among these digital filters the group of filters that have finite duration of impulse response are called FIR (finite impulse response) filters and are having the preference over other groups of filters in the classification as their linearity and standard signal processing characteristics are conducive for implementing in microprocessors and DSP's (digital signal processor). As the ever-changing reforms in technology take place, a system with reconfigurable design has to be provided in order to cope up with the transitions in the research timeline and since there have been many years of ongoing research in the branch of FIR filters with reconfigurable design an analysis of this research is presented by studying the design approach and proposed architectures by various researchers from the last 20 years.
